notes.zh: 这份报告介绍 Isaac Jev，一个面向《以撒的结合》的游戏智能体。玩家在房间之间战斗并收集资源。项目将较长期的规划与快速战斗决策分开，使用结构化游戏数据，以及本项目自行训练的战斗模型。
notes.en: This talk introduces Isaac Jev, an agent for The Binding of Isaac, a game where the player fights and collects resources room by room. The project separates longer-term planning from fast combat decisions. It uses structured game data and a combat model trained within this project.

notes.zh:
框架连接游戏采集、高层规划与实时战斗。游戏模组采集位置、生命、实体和房间几何。本地 Python 状态桥录制数据，并管理执行。

dsh 语言助手选择探索房间、拾取物品等目标。战斗模型运行在 L40S GPU 上，选择短时移动和射击动作。本地执行器负责导航、切换到战斗，并返回实际观察到的进展。
notes.en:
The framework links game sensing, high-level planning and real-time combat. A game mod collects positions, health, entities and room geometry. A local Python bridge records the data and manages execution.

The dsh language assistant chooses goals, such as exploring a room or collecting an item. The combat model runs on an L40S GPU and selects short movement and shooting actions. The local executor handles navigation, switches into combat, and returns observed progress.

source.zh: TerraBlind 的 Jev 战斗链路调用 TypeSafe；本项目借鉴文本方法，自行训练相似思想的 Jev 式决策模型。
source.en: TerraBlind’s Jev combat pipeline calls TypeSafe. This project adapts its text method and trains its own Jev-style policy.

notes.zh:
文本设计借鉴 TerraBlind 的状态事实、目标与候选动作描述。它的战斗链路调用 TypeSafe Jev；本项目自行训练基于 Qwen 的决策头。

当前 Qwen 输入已经很复杂，包含武器能力、道具效果、威胁几何、路线和实时反馈。把与行动相关的文本关系组织清楚，有助于模型比较选项。实机观察提示，这种改进可以帮助战斗决策，但其收益仍需与数据和训练变化分开验证。

这个任务的意义，是让预训练语言模型的语义能力进入快速战斗决策循环。脚本计算事实，模型利用语言表征比较有意义的动作。未知信息保持未知，未来结果只用于训练监督。
notes.en:
TerraBlind inspired our use of state facts, goals and candidate consequences. Its combat pipeline calls TypeSafe’s Jev. Here, we train our own Qwen-based decision heads.

Our Qwen input is already complex: weapon abilities, item effects, threat geometry, routes and feedback. Clear, action-relevant text helps the model compare these relationships. Playtest observations suggest this can improve combat decisions, although its effect still needs to be isolated from data and training changes.

The aim is to bring pretrained semantic knowledge into a fast combat loop. Scripts calculate facts, while the model compares meaningful action choices. Unknown facts stay unknown, and future outcomes provide training supervision only.

exampleText.zh:
战斗目标：安全推进并快速清敌

能力：武器机制、已知道具效果
状态：相对位置、攻击机会、威胁
候选：9 种移动的风险与射击几何
路线：可达攻击位、下一路标
反馈：已生效输入、生命与敌人进展
阶段：动画、碰撞、可能落地风险

模型选择移动与射击，共 45 种组合
exampleText.en:
Goal: safe progress and prompt elimination

Abilities: weapon and known item effects
State: relative threats and attack access
Candidates: 9 moves and shooting geometry
Routes: attack position, next waypoint
Feedback: applied input, health, progress
Phases: animation, collision, landing risk

Model selects movement and shooting

title.zh:
自训练 Jev 架构
冻结主干与独立动作决策塔
title.en:
Our Jev-style architecture
Frozen backbone and trained action towers

subtitle.zh: V010：共享 2,048 维文本特征，分别融合 1,018 维数值输入
subtitle.en: V010 shares a 2,048-D text embedding. Each tower fuses it with 1,018 numeric features.

backbone.zh: 冻结 Qwen3.5-2B 文本主干

pool.zh: 最后有效 token 池化：2048 维

numeric.zh: 归一化数值输入：1,018 维

sharing.zh:
两个动作塔的参数独立
主干保持冻结
sharing.en:
Independent action towers
The language backbone stays frozen

active.zh: 当前仅输出移动与射击

quality.zh:
训练辅助：7 维质量 × 5 等级
推理只走移动 / 射击两塔
quality.en:
Training auxiliary: 7 axes × 5 levels
Inference uses the two action towers

source.zh: 按 V010 权重逐张量统计；总参数含 72,947 个质量辅助参数。自行训练动作头，不调用 TypeSafe 原生 Jev。
source.en: Counts come from V010 tensors and include 72,947 quality-auxiliary parameters. Our action heads are trained without TypeSafe’s native Jev.

notes.zh:
冻结的 Qwen 主干一次编码当前场景，得到 2,048 维文本特征。独立的移动和射击塔分别结合 1,018 维数值特征，输出九种移动与五种射击状态，覆盖 45 种组合。约一百万个决策头参数参与训练，其中包括仅训练使用的质量辅助头。

Jev 式架构的优势，是把丰富的语言表征直接接到动作选择上。如果每次都让生成式 LLM 逐 token 生成完整分析和动作说明，就会增加战斗循环的延迟。这里通过决策头直接输出控制动作。一条已测 V009 的 L40S 请求中，模型计算约 53 毫秒，不含网络与游戏执行。

与 BERT 这类较小的文本编码器相比，采用 Qwen 是为了探索更丰富语义知识与能力描述的迁移潜力。
notes.en:
The frozen Qwen backbone encodes the situation once into 2,048 features. Independent movement and shooting towers combine these with 1,018 numeric features and select 45 action combinations. About one million head parameters are trained, including a training-only quality auxiliary.

This is the Jev-style advantage: rich language features feed direct action selection. Generating a full reasoning trace and action description token by token would add latency to every combat update. Our head selects controls without generating that text. One measured V009 request on L40S used about 53 milliseconds for model computation, excluding network and game execution.

Compared with a smaller text encoder such as BERT, using Qwen aims to transfer richer semantic and capability knowledge.

subtitle.zh: 行为协议规定资源运营与通关目标，工具选择和执行反馈构成闭环
subtitle.en: The protocol prioritizes resource management and run completion through tools and execution feedback.

protocolText.zh: 资源运营、任务流程与道具知识
protocolText.en: Resource priorities, workflow and item knowledge

toolsText.zh: 同一注册表与 JSON Schema
toolsText.en: One registry and shared JSON schemas

runtimeText.zh: 导航、战斗交接与目标确认
runtimeText.en: Navigation, combat handoff and goal confirmation

count.zh: 16 个基础工具，按职责分组

control.zh: 只提交工具生成的目标 ID

result.zh: 管理生命、钥匙、金币与道具，推进通关
result.en: Manage health, keys, coins and items to progress

source.zh: 高层按事件选择目标；本地运行时持续执行导航与 Jev 战斗。工具回执与目标完成判定分开记录。
source.en: Planning selects goals on events; local navigation and Jev combat continue asynchronously. Tool ACKs and goal completion remain separate records.

notes.zh:
dsh skill 定义助手如何使用工具。目标是在推进通关的过程中管理生命、钥匙、金币和道具。它观察游戏，从工具生成的合法候选中选择并提交目标，再等待反馈。

十六个基础工具涵盖状态、知识、规划和会话控制。本地运行时负责执行，只有观察到预期的游戏状态变化，才判定任务成功。
notes.en:
The dsh skill defines how the assistant uses tools. Its goal is to manage health, keys, coins and items while progressing toward completing the run. It observes the game, chooses a valid tool-generated goal, submits that goal, and waits for feedback.

Sixteen base tools cover state, knowledge, planning and session control. The local runtime handles execution. A task succeeds when the expected game-state change is observed.

scriptPairs.zh: 时间轴概括了项目的演进。V003 到 V005 建立文本与数值融合、动作时序对齐及能力上下文；V006 和 V007 比较标注、文本格式与决策头；V008 筛选优质示范；V009 增加执行和进展反馈；V010 增加稳定攻击路线与阶段信息。
scriptPairs.en: The timeline summarizes the development. V003 to V005 established text-and-number fusion, control alignment and ability context. V006 and V007 compared labeling, text formats and decision heads. V008 selected higher-quality demonstrations. V009 added execution and progress feedback. V010 added stable attack routes and phase information.

scriptPairs.zh: 后续有三个方向。第一，继续提高数据数量和质量，补充缺失的敌人、武器及攻击阶段。第二，继续完善 Jev 文本格式，让能力、候选动作后果和实时反馈更清楚。第三，继续完善 dsh skill 的资源运营、探索与异常恢复能力。最终期望仅凭借这套架构实现游戏完整通关。
scriptPairs.en: Three directions come next. First, increase both the amount and quality of data, including missing enemies, weapons and attack phases. Second, improve Jev’s text format so abilities, candidate consequences and feedback are clearer. Third, expand the dsh skill’s resource management, exploration and recovery capabilities. The goal is to complete a full game run using this architecture.

notes.en:
The timeline summarizes the development. V003 to V005 established text-and-number fusion, control alignment and ability context. V006 and V007 compared labeling, text formats and decision heads. V008 selected higher-quality demonstrations. V009 added execution and progress feedback. V010 added stable attack routes and phase information.

Three directions come next. First, increase both the amount and quality of data, including missing enemies, weapons and attack phases. Second, improve Jev’s text format so abilities, candidate consequences and feedback are clearer. Third, expand the dsh skill’s resource management, exploration and recovery capabilities. The goal is to complete a full game run using this architecture.

title.zh: 附录：V010 层设计与参数量

subtitle.zh: 1,002,753 个可训练参数；动作推理两塔与仅训练使用的质量辅助头
subtitle.en: 1,002,753 trainable parameters: two action towers and a training-only quality auxiliary head

activation.zh: 投影与融合层使用 GELU；融合后 Dropout(0.1) 只在训练启用。辅助头输出 7 × 5 个质量等级 logits。
activation.en: GELU follows projections and fusion. Dropout(0.1) is enabled during training only. The auxiliary head predicts 7 × 5 quality logits.

source.zh: 逐张量统计 V010 的 head.safetensors；冻结语言主干不计入可训练参数。质量辅助头不用于推理动作选择。
source.en: Counts derive from V010 head tensors. The frozen backbone is excluded. The quality auxiliary does not select actions during inference.

notes.zh: V010 动作两塔共有 929,806 个参数。文本投影每塔 266,624，数值投影 130,688，融合层 65,792。质量辅助头包含 45 × 16 的动作嵌入，以及 528 到 128、128 到 35 的两层网络，共 72,947 个参数，仅用于训练。相加得到 1,002,753。
notes.en: V010’s two action towers contain 929,806 parameters. Each text projection has 266,624, numeric projection 130,688 and fusion 65,792. The quality auxiliary combines a 45-by-16 action embedding with 528-to-128 and 128-to-35 linear layers, adding 72,947 training-only parameters. The total is 1,002,753.

title.zh: 附录：早期九组实验结果

subtitle.zh: V006 的 E01–E09 对照，测试使用 2,881 条 positive 子集；不与新测试集直接比较
subtitle.en: V006 E01–E09 comparison on a 2,881-sample positive test subset; different from the recent test set

source.zh: 验证 3,230 条、测试 2,881 条；NLL 对 Boss / 普通房、近 / 远威胁四组等权平均
source.en: 3,230 validation and 2,881 test samples. NLL averages four boss / ordinary and near / far threat groups equally.

notes.zh: 这些是早期 V006 的九组对照实验，比较标注、文本和决策头设计，每组训练三十轮。它们使用 2,881 条 positive 测试子集，与新版 3,079 条完整测试集不同，不能直接按表中准确率作跨阶段排名。TypeSafe 原生 Jev 的内部基座与冻结方式没有在所核对资料中确认，本报告的具体架构只描述本项目自行训练的模型。
notes.en: These earlier V006 experiments compare annotations, text and decision heads, with thirty epochs each. They use a 2,881-sample positive test subset, which differs from the recent full 3,079-sample test set. The percentages do not support a direct cross-stage ranking. TypeSafe’s internal base model and freezing policy have not been verified. The concrete architecture in this talk describes this project’s own trained model.
